entry.summary: Australians can visit Bermuda without a visa for up to 180 days in any 12 months. You need a return or onward ticket and a Bermuda Arrival Card if arriving by air. Australia isn't on the visa-controlled list (Prohibition of Entry Order 2025).
entry.next_check: Confirm with Bermuda's immigration authority before travel.
